messages:
maria: starting late-shift rollout window — plan is US -> EU -> APAC, staged slices (20% -> 50% -> 100%). @ops-lead i'll monitor capacity and holdpoints.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: release v2.14.3 (sha: d4f2a7e). initial slices: us=20%, eu=0%, apac=0%. warm pools: us-west 12/12 ready. logs: `deploybot://runs/1766123456`

sam: quick question — can we prepare a pin for EU fallback (v2.14.2) that we can flip in <1m? want a manual rollback option if latency spikes.

lee: adding checkers to the canary scoreboard: metrics -> p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, OOMs. thresholds proposed: p99 > 220ms OR 5xx > 0.5% => hold/rollback.

deploy-bot: us slice ramp to 50% after warmup. metrics snapshot: p50=65ms, p95=120ms, p99=210ms, 5xx=0.12%. no OOMs.

ana: note: background batch jobs caused temporary GPU pressure on us-west earlier; drained 2 nodes pre-rollout. warm pool adjusted.

ops-lead: confirmed warm-pool reserve 10% in us. dashboards: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/rollout-1766123456 (monitoring live)

maria: EU is a hold point — we need stable p99 < 230ms for a continuous 10m before ramping beyond 20%. if tail moves up we'll pin and escalate. @sam pls stand by.

deploy-bot: eu slice ramp to 20%. metrics: p50=70ms, p95=130ms, p99=245ms (+17% vs baseline), 5xx=0.34%. alert: eu-p99-high (sent to #eng-oncall).

sam: seeing transient GC spikes on eu-gpu-03 (logs attached). i'm restarting agent on eu-gpu-03 now.

lee: after restart p99 improved to ~205ms. recommendation: keep EU at 20% for another 15m and re-evaluate. this avoids noisy rollback.

deploy-bot: ramp hold extended for eu. rollback ready: pinned-version=v2.14.2 (sha a1b2c3). to run manual rollback: `deploybot rollback --region eu --version v2.14.2 --reason "p99 spike"`

ops-lead: procedure: if eu p99 > 260ms for 5m OR 5xx > 0.5% for 3m -> auto-rollback to pinned-version and page oncall. i've set those thresholds on the alerting rule.

maria: APAC scheduled warmup at 02:00 UTC, cutover at 02:15 UTC local. i'll kick warmup 15m prior. any capacity notes?

ana: APAC cluster has a maintenance window 02:00-02:10 UTC (non-disruptive), but i left an extra 8 nodes warm. we'll still watch the first 10m of traffic closely.

deploy-bot: current status: US stable at 50%, EU on hold at 20% (metrics improving), APAC pending. release notes: https://console.redwood/releases/2.14.3 — key changes: batching improvements, kernel selection fix, kvcache eviction bugfix.

maria: thanks everyone — will keep this thread updated during APAC warmup. if anyone sees regressions tag @ops-lead and call the rollback command. :thumbsup:
